title: Player state
description: One seat's off-board holdings. Setup: money 17, income space 10 (level 0), 14 links, 45 mat tiles, a hand of 8.

id.description: Player id, "0" through "3". The same key this record is filed under in game-state.players.

money.description: Cash in hand. Starts at 17. May not go negative; a shortfall is what a Loan is for.

income-space.description: Position on the 100-space income track, NOT the income level. Level is levelFromSpace(space) and the mapping is non-linear. Starts at 10, which is level 0.

vp.description: Victory points banked by end-of-era scoring.

spent.description: Money spent this round. Reset each round; ascending order of this value is next round's turn order.

hand.description: Private. Replaced by hidden placeholders for every other seat before broadcast.

discard.description: Public. Reshuffled back into the deck at the canal-to-rail transition.

additionalProperties.description: Remaining tile levels, ascending. A build always takes element 0.

mat.description: Six stacks of remaining tiles. Only the head of each is buildable, which is what makes Develop necessary.

links-left.description: Unplaced link tokens. Starts at 14. A rail double build needs two.
